title: Red String Clues - Link four words, solve cases
short: Sixteen word cards on a cork board. String four together to uncover each hidden link.
desc:
Sixteen word cards are pinned to a cork board. Tap four that share something in common and a red string runs between their pins; press "Tie" to check. Find all four links before your four strings run out to close the case.

· Today's Case: one board per date, the same for everyone on that day.
· Case Files: each solve opens the next file, and deeper files bring in more wordplay links.
· Clue Notebook: every link you uncover is collected.
· "One away" tells you when you are close, and a combination you already tried never costs a string.
· One magnifying lens per case points out two cards that belong together.

Leaderboard
Pick a nickname to put your stamp count on the weekly and all-time boards (optional).

· Korean and English puzzles are written separately for each language.

A short ad may appear between rounds (at most once every 2.5 minutes). No purchases, no sign-in.

This app was planned and built with the help of AI tools.
